tools.name: groq_list_models
tools.description: List the models available to this Groq account, with their ids, owners, context window and status. Use the id in groq_create_chat_completion. Groq API: GET /openai/v1/models.

tools.name: groq_list_batches
tools.description: List the batch jobs of this organization, with status and request counts. Groq API: GET /openai/v1/batches.

tools.name: groq_get_batch
tools.description: Get one batch job by id: status, endpoint, input and output file ids, and timestamps. Groq API: GET /openai/v1/batches/{batch_id}.

tools.name: groq_list_files
tools.description: List the files uploaded to this organization (batch inputs and batch outputs). Groq API: GET /openai/v1/files.

tools.name: groq_get_file
tools.description: Get the metadata of one file by id: name, purpose, size and creation time. Groq API: GET /openai/v1/files/{file_id}.

tools.name: groq_get_file_content
tools.description: Read the text of one file, for example a batch output in JSONL. Returns at most 200000 characters and says when it cut the text. Groq API: GET /openai/v1/files/{file_id}/content.

tools.name: groq_create_chat_completion
tools.description: Run one chat completion on a Groq model and return the reply with token usage. This call is billed to the Groq account (tokens). Non-streaming only. Groq API: POST /openai/v1/chat/completions.

tools.name: groq_create_batch
tools.description: Start a batch job from a JSONL input file already uploaded with purpose 'batch'. The job runs asynchronously and is billed to the Groq account. Groq API: POST /openai/v1/batches.

tools.name: groq_cancel_batch
tools.description: Cancel a batch job that has not finished. Requests already completed stay in the output file. Groq API: POST /openai/v1/batches/{batch_id}/cancel.

tools.name: groq_delete_file
tools.description: Delete one uploaded file permanently. A batch that still needs this input file can fail. Groq API: DELETE /openai/v1/files/{file_id}.
